检查条件和阶段是否发生变化，据此调整原有判断的适用范围。

hash_semantics.line_sha256_without_eol: SHA256 of UTF-8 source JSONL/log line excluding CR/LF
hash_semantics.snapshot_id: orientation snapshot identifier including lineage metadata
hash_semantics.items_sha256: SHA256 of canonical literal principle list, not semantic equivalence
hash_semantics.baseline_phi_file_sha256: actual orientation file byte hash recorded by runtime hook

limitations: Presence establishes transmission and potential guidance, not adherence or independent causal effects on generated code or task performance.
The actor context role also covers downstream tool/model calls; not every actor-labelled request contains full Phi text. Counts and all matching/nonmatching line receipts are retained.
none removes only the additional Phi list and retains native M/cold-start instructions.
Original failed and completed prefixes are audited equally; supplement scores do not select these seven IDs.

actor_role_scope_source.explanation: audit_scope(role=actor) spans runner.process_item; nested tool extraction calls can inherit this role
actor_role_scope_source.per_request_caller_identification: not recorded, so absent-Phi requests are not individually attributed to a specific helper
